title: {Syn} The Ulam Spiral Makes Primes Look Like Constellations
content:
Write positive integers in a square spiral and mark the primes. Diagonal streaks appear because many quadratic polynomials produce prime-rich runs.

The Ulam spiral is not a proof machine, but it is a wonderful reminder that visual experiments can expose arithmetic texture.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
